entries.label: Run all unit tests
entries.description: All unit tests with node --test (npm run test:auth). Writes nothing to the repo.

entries.label: Lint
entries.command: rm -rf ~/rabbit-web && cp -r --no-preserve=mode /workspace/rabbit-web ~/rabbit-web && cd ~/rabbit-web && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run lint
entries.description: Installs dependencies in a writable copy under your home folder, then runs ESLint (npm run lint).

entries.label: Type check
entries.command: rm -rf ~/rabbit-web && cp -r --no-preserve=mode /workspace/rabbit-web ~/rabbit-web && cd ~/rabbit-web && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npx tsc --noEmit
entries.description: Installs dependencies in a writable copy, then runs npx tsc --noEmit (README.md).

entries.label: Build the vinext app
entries.command: rm -rf ~/rabbit-web && cp -r --no-preserve=mode /workspace/rabbit-web ~/rabbit-web && cd ~/rabbit-web && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build:vinext
entries.description: Builds the Cloudflare/vinext bundle in a writable copy (npm run build:vinext). Does not deploy.

entries.label: Start the dev server (port 3001)
entries.command: rm -rf ~/rabbit-web && cp -r --no-preserve=mode /workspace/rabbit-web ~/rabbit-web && cd ~/rabbit-web && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run dev:vinext
entries.description: Runs vite dev on port 3001 inside the sandbox (npm run dev:vinext). Stop it with Ctrl+C. No inbound ports are exposed, so use curl localhost:3001.

entries.label: Write static security headers
entries.description: Writes public/_headers from src/lib/security-headers.ts in a writable copy (scripts/write-static-headers.mjs).

entries.label: Make twin interop test fixtures
entries.description: Writes two throwaway TEST identities, a request and a response to ~/ts-twin.json (scripts/make-twin-fixtures.mjs). Test keys only.

entries.label: Pathways: check VS Code, GitHub, Google Cloud, network, research and blockchain together
entries.description: Read only. About 30 checks across this PC, GitHub, Google Cloud, the websites, the research feed and the chains; exit code 1 if anything failed. Add --report to save the result to ~/RabbitOS/logs and gs://rabbitsoftware-io-reports/pathways/latest.json, --roundtrip to also follow one marker note from the vault to Google Cloud and search (about 4 minutes, writes Ops/Pathway check.md), --json for machine-readable output.

entries.label: Back up Downloads, Desktop, Documents, Pictures, Music, Videos and key settings to Google Cloud (preview)
entries.description: Counts what would be sent and lists skipped key-like files; uploads nothing. Run it without -WhatIf to upload, or with -Register to create the nightly 01:30 task (-Remove deletes it). Adds and updates only; never deletes in the bucket. Skips .env, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*, *.kdbx, files over 2 GB and node_modules. AppData is not copied wholesale (browser profiles and tokens live there); only VS Code settings and extension list, Windows Terminal settings and .gitconfig are.

entries.label: Back up Hugging Face buckets and datasets to Google Cloud (preview)
entries.description: Lists your Hugging Face buckets and datasets (including private ones) and uploads nothing. Needs hf auth login on this PC. Run without -WhatIf to copy them to the private backups bucket (huggingface/), or with -Register for the nightly 02:30 task. Adds and updates only.

entries.label: Download and verify the public chain ledger
entries.command: cd /workspace/rabbit-web && node scripts/chain-export.mjs export https://app.rabbitsoftware.io ~/chain.jsonl && node scripts/chain-export.mjs verify ~/chain.jsonl
entries.description: Reads GET /api/chain/ledger from the public origin, checks every hash link, saves ~/chain.jsonl, then verifies the saved file (scripts/chain-export.mjs).

entries.label: Data hub: list the datasets
entries.description: Reads GET /api/data: every dataset with columns, row counts, endpoints and the ledger head. Public and read-only (docs/rabbitos.md, Data hub).

entries.label: Data hub: Research records
entries.description: Reads the first 50 rows of the public research_records dataset (GET /api/data/research_records). Add &format=csv or &q=text. Read-only.

entries.label: Load the RabbitNet module (run in PowerShell on your PC)
entries.description: Run in PowerShell on your PC, from the rabbit-web folder. Loads Test-RabbitConnection, Get-RabbitChainHead and Sync-RabbitChain. Default connection is your normal one (no proxy).

entries.label: Check the RabbitOS connection (run in PowerShell on your PC)
entries.description: Run in PowerShell on your PC after Import-Module. DNS, TCP 443, TLS, HTTP status and latency for app.rabbitsoftware.io and /api/chain/head. Add -NetworkTools for extra diagnostics (asks first).

entries.label: Pull and verify the public ledger (run in PowerShell on your PC)
entries.description: Run in PowerShell on your PC after Import-Module. Pulls the public ledger into a local .jsonl, verifies the hash chain, refuses a broken one. Uploads nothing.

entries.label: Run the PC witness of the Maxwell chain
entries.description: Re-checks the public chain with the Python verifier and the JavaScript witness; only if both pass it signs the head with the PC witness key and publishes the signature. Drop -WhatIf to run. The private key never leaves the PC.

entries.label: Research search from the terminal (antigravity)
entries.description: Asks the RabbitOS Hub for research_link: live OpenAlex, INSPIRE-HEP, Europe PMC and PubMed results, what RabbitOS stores, and whether the Maxwell research anchor covers it. Add --sources openalex,inspirehep or --json. Read only.

entries.label: Connect Google Antigravity to the RabbitOS Hub
entries.description: Registers the Hub MCP with the agy CLI so Antigravity can call research_link and research_search. Public read-only tools, no key. Drop -WhatIf to apply; -Remove undoes it.

entries.label: Bundle the GitHub mirrors and copy them to Google Cloud
entries.description: Packs each mirror into a verified git bundle and uploads them to the private vault bucket. Nothing is deleted. Drop -WhatIf to run.

entries.label: List or restore a GitHub mirror from Google Cloud
entries.description: Lists the bundles in the cloud. Add -Repo NAME -Target FOLDER to restore one (checked against the manifest hash). Pushes nothing.

entries.label: Next dev server
entries.description: npm run dev on http://localhost:3000. Needs your .env.local (README.md).

entries.label: Verify AI providers (your keys)
entries.description: Lists Gemini models, sends one tiny request to each provider whose key is set in your environment, checks the CLI packages with npm view, and prints PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED. Never prints keys. With no keys only the npm checks run.

entries.label: Build console: local-primary
entries.description: vite build --mode local-primary, then scripts/check-console-build.mjs. Build only; the latest build replaces the previous target.

entries.label: Build console: cloud-supabase
entries.description: Isolated Supabase console build and output check (README.md). Build only.

entries.label: Build console: cloud-access
entries.description: Isolated Cloudflare Access console build and output check (README.md). Build only.

entries.label: Preview the vinext build
entries.description: vite preview of an existing build.

entries.label: Deploy production (app.rabbitsoftware.io)
entries.description: Production deploy to Cloudflare. Run it only deliberately and with an explicit go-ahead (CLAUDE.md, README.md).

entries.label: Deploy console: local-primary
entries.description: vinext-cloudflare deploy --env local-primary. Main production; README.md says leave it untouched unless separately requested.

entries.label: Deploy console: cloud-supabase
entries.description: Deploys the isolated Supabase console Worker. Only after explicit deployment approval (README.md).

entries.label: Deploy console: cloud-access
entries.description: Deploys the isolated Access console Worker. Only after explicit deployment approval (README.md).

entries.label: Cloud console deploy script: cloud-supabase
entries.description: README.md form of scripts/deploy-cloud-console.mjs. Reads an ignored secrets file and your vault; deploys.

entries.label: Cloud console deploy script: cloud-access
entries.description: README.md form of scripts/deploy-cloud-console.mjs for the Access console. Reads an ignored secrets file and your vault; deploys.

entries.label: Create the chain mirror R2 bucket
entries.command: npx wrangler r2 bucket create rabbitos-chain-mirror
entries.description: One-time setup from docs/rabbitos.md, then deploy so the binding exists.

entries.label: List R2 buckets
entries.description: Checks the chain mirror bucket exists (docs/rabbitos.md). Uses your Cloudflare login.

entries.label: Snapshot the API schema
entries.description: Writes a structural snapshot of the Supabase public schema into supabase/schema/ (scripts/snapshot-api-schema.mjs). Read-only, uses the service role.

entries.label: Dump the full schema
entries.description: Writes supabase/schema/full_schema.sql (scripts/dump-schema.mjs). Read-only, needs the database URL.

entries.label: Push missing chain events to the site
entries.description: Signed POST to /api/chain/import for events the site is missing (scripts/chain-export.mjs). Writes remote data.

entries.label: Rebuild MeSH concept IDs
entries.description: Looks up MeSH IDs live and rewrites src/lib/concepts.generated.json (scripts/build-concepts.mjs). Its host is not on the public sandbox allowlist.

entries.label: Add UMLS CUIs (asks for your key)
entries.description: PowerShell helper that asks for your UMLS key privately and adds CUIs to the body model (scripts/add-umls.ps1).

entries.label: Create contact record keys
entries.description: Writes your PRIVATE key outside the repo and the public key to .dev.vars (scripts/contact-keys.mjs). Run it yourself, on your machine.

entries.label: Contact key self-test
entries.description: Proves a private key matches the public key the site uses (scripts/contact-lookup.mjs selftest). No database access.

entries.label: Open a contact record (legal request)
entries.description: Opens one record for a valid legal request and writes an append-only access log (docs/legal-requests.md).

entries.label: Purge expired contact records
entries.command: npm run contacts:lookup -- purge-expired --reason "monthly retention purge" --ref "retention policy"
entries.description: Retention purge from docs/legal-requests.md.

Cloud Run job rabbit-research-explorer every hour at :20: reads the topic queue from the RabbitOS app, explores up to two queued topics on public sources (PubMed, Europe PMC, ClinicalTrials.gov) and ingests the results (topic explored, run, records) through the signed ingest. Keeps no files; reads only the ingest secret.

Prefer Run-DnaLocal.ps1, which loads the signing key for you.

entries.description: Stages one short note per worker (research, task_worker) through the echo, only when it changed since the last one. The echo task also does this hourly.

entries.label: rabbit_sync dry run
entries.description: Prints what would be sent; sends nothing.

entries.label: rabbit_sync one pass
entries.description: Pushes local state to the signed ingest endpoint (RABBIT_NODE_ID is optional with one node).

entries.label: rabbit_sync every 5 minutes
entries.description: Repeats the sync every 300 seconds.

entries.label: maxwell_adopt dry run (run on your PC)
entries.description: Run on your PC, from the research-agents folder. Reads the public Maxwell chain, verifies it, and says whether this PC is the same, ahead, or behind (cloud blocks to adopt). Writes nothing; add --apply to adopt.

entries.label: maxwell_chain_sync dry run (run on your PC)
entries.description: Run on your PC, from the research-agents folder. Verifies maxwell_chain.json and prints which new blocks would be mirrored to the public ledger; sends nothing and writes no state. Without --dry-run it posts the new blocks to /api/ingest/maxwell-chain (needs RABBIT_URL and RABBIT_INGEST_SECRET).

entries.label: run_all (chain, research agent, AI participant, audit)
entries.description: The single entry point that launches everything under one project identifier.

entries.label: chain_pull once
entries.description: Pulls and verifies the public ledger into a local JSONL copy. No secret needed; a broken chain is refused (exit 2). The repo is not in the public sandbox.

entries.label: chain_pull once from app.rabbitsoftware.io
entries.description: Same, with the origin given explicitly.

entries.label: brain_research
entries.description: Searches PubMed and Europe PMC for EEG, chemistry and gene papers; writes brain_records.json.

entries.label: brain_research, 3 per query
entries.description: Fewer results per query.

entries.label: physics_research (antigravity)
entries.description: Searches OpenAlex and INSPIRE-HEP for antigravity and antihydrogen gravity papers; writes physics_records.json for the research sync.

entries.label: physics_research for one topic
entries.description: Same, for words you choose.

entries.label: neuro_variants
entries.description: ClinVar variant counts and examples for the brain genes; writes neuro_records.json and neuro_gene_counts.json.

entries.label: neuro_variants for COMT
entries.description: One gene.

entries.label: crispr_data (BRCA1)
entries.description: Transcripts, guides and literature for one gene; writes crispr_records.json. Text and public data only.

entries.label: crispr_data (BRCA1, no literature)
entries.description: Skips the literature search.

entries.label: crispr_research_suite
entries.description: All four pieces together.

entries.label: crispr_cancer_research
entries.description: Literature only (trials, papers, preprints).

entries.label: crispr_tool: guides for BRCA1
entries.description: Top guides on a built-in gene (RefSeq transcript downloaded once and cached).

entries.label: crispr_tool: preview a 1-base deletion
entries.description: Edit preview that reports the protein change.

entries.label: bio_networks (ping public data sources)
entries.description: Pings every public source and prints status and latency (--json for machines).

entries.label: brainflow_bridge dry run (synthetic board)
entries.description: Synthetic board; prints and sends nothing (eeg-brainflow skill). Personal EEG stays on your computer.

entries.label: Test: chain_pull
entries.description: Hash check against a vector made by the web app code.
